description: Get a paginated list of WhatsApp group conversations. Read-only: listing groups never marks anything as read. Counts report what has not been opened in the LetsBot inbox, which is not the same as what the merchant has seen on their own phone. Use get_group_messages to read a group's history.

filter.description: Filter groups. "not_opened_in_inbox" = has inbound messages nobody has opened in the LetsBot inbox (inbox state only, not the merchant's phone).

membership.description: Membership filter: all (default — matches the live-chat list), joined (still a member), left (removed from or left the group)

name: get_groups
